facts.control_label: segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment
facts.doc_title: Haul Road and Light Vehicle Interaction

setpoint.label: light vehicle exclusion radius from operating haul trucks

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop

response.body: This requirement is withdrawn. The segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment is no longer imposed by this procedure; the duty is discharged under the document that supersedes this clause. The light vehicle exclusion radius from operating haul trucks shall be set at 50 m.
